FIELD.NAME: mediatype
FIELD.COMMENT: audio or video - see SPEAKUP_MEDIA_* constants

FIELD.NAME: gradingmethod
FIELD.COMMENT: auto (automated) or manual - see SPEAKUP_GRADING_* constants

FIELD.NAME: sttlanguage
FIELD.COMMENT: BCP-47 language tag used for live browser speech recognition, e.g. en-US, ja-JP

FIELD.NAME: allowpause
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the student may pause/resume mid-recording. Off by default.

FIELD.NAME: aiproviderid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to qtype_speakup_ai_providers.id - which admin-configured AI provider to use for AI assessment, if gradingmethod involves AI.

FIELD.NAME: responsemethod
FIELD.COMMENT: How the student gives their response: record (live in the browser) or upload (an audio or video file) - see SPEAKUP_RESPONSE_* constants

FIELD.NAME: aiassessment
FIELD.COMMENT: For automated grading: whether the response is also assessed by AI.

FIELD.NAME: aiweighting
FIELD.COMMENT: For automated grading with AI assessment: the percentage of the question grade given by the AI's score (0-100).

FIELD.NAME: showcalculation
FIELD.COMMENT: Who sees how the automated grade was calculated: 0 nobody, 1 students only, 2 teachers only, 3 teachers and students - see SPEAKUP_SHOW_* constants

FIELD.NAME: showphrases
FIELD.COMMENT: Who sees which target phrases were used - see SPEAKUP_SHOW_* constants

FIELD.NAME: showitems
FIELD.COMMENT: Who sees the target item values - see SPEAKUP_SHOW_* constants

FIELD.NAME: showcomment
FIELD.COMMENT: Who sees the grading comment (e.g. the AI's feedback) - see SPEAKUP_SHOW_* constants

FIELD.NAME: showtranscript
FIELD.COMMENT: Who sees the transcript of the response - see SPEAKUP_SHOW_* constants

FIELD.NAME: showstats
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether statistics about the transcript are shown when the response is reviewed: 0 no, 1 yes.

FIELD.NAME: statsitems
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated list of the statistics to show, e.g. words,uniquewords - see text_stats::get_stat_types()

FIELD.NAME: audioprompttranscript
FIELD.COMMENT: Transcript of the audio prompt, e.g. for students who cannot hear it.

FIELD.NAME: prompttranscriptdisplay
FIELD.COMMENT: How the audio prompt transcript is shown to students: 0 not shown, 1 collapsed, 2 expanded - see SPEAKUP_PROMPTTRANSCRIPT_* constants

FIELD.NAME: transcriptpenalty
FIELD.COMMENT: Percent (0-100) of the question grade taken off if a student shows the collapsed transcript, unless they have qtype/speakup:viewtranscriptwithoutpenalty.

FIELD.NAME: recordafterprompt
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = start recording as soon as the prompt (the audio prompt, or else the first audio in the question text) finishes.

FIELD.NAME: maxpromptplays
FIELD.COMMENT: How many times the prompt can be played: 0 for no limit.

FIELD.NAME: maxresponses
FIELD.COMMENT: How many responses (recordings or uploads) can be given: 0 for no limit.

FIELD.NAME: silencestop
FIELD.COMMENT: Stop recording after this many seconds of silence, once the student has started speaking: 0 for never.

TABLE.NAME: qtype_speakup_answers
TABLE.COMMENT: Target phrases for automated grading of SpeakUp questions.

FIELD.NAME: percent
FIELD.COMMENT: Percent (0-100) of the question grade awarded if this phrase is used, before dividing by divisor.

FIELD.NAME: divisor
FIELD.COMMENT: The percent is divided by this (1-20), e.g. 100% divided by 3 = 33.33%.

FIELD.NAME: fullmatch
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = match whole words only; 0 = also match part of a word.

TABLE.NAME: qtype_speakup_items
TABLE.COMMENT: Target items for automated grading of SpeakUp questions, e.g. the number of words or the speech rate.

FIELD.NAME: itemtype
FIELD.COMMENT: What is counted, e.g. words, uniquewords or speechrate - see the ITEM_ constants in classes/text_stats.php

FIELD.NAME: itemcount
FIELD.COMMENT: The target value. At or above it, the full award is given; below it, award x value / itemcount.

FIELD.NAME: percent
FIELD.COMMENT: Percent (0-100) of the question grade awarded at the target, before multiplying by multiplier.

FIELD.NAME: multiplier
FIELD.COMMENT: The percent is multiplied by this (1-10), e.g. 20% multiplied by 2 = 40%.

TABLE.NAME: qtype_speakup_response
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-attempt transcript and AI feedback for SpeakUp responses.

FIELD.NAME: transcript
FIELD.COMMENT: The live transcript from the browser's speech recognition, if any.

FIELD.NAME: aitranscript
FIELD.COMMENT: The transcript made by the AI provider, if any. Used for grading in place of the live transcript.

FIELD.NAME: transcriptstatus
FIELD.COMMENT: pending, done, failed

FIELD.NAME: aistatus
FIELD.COMMENT: pending, done, failed, notapplicable

TABLE.NAME: qtype_speakup_ai_providers
TABLE.COMMENT: Admin-configured AI providers, selectable per question. Credentials live here (admin-only), never on individual questions.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Display name shown to teachers in the question-editing form, e.g. 'OpenAI GPT-4o'.

FIELD.NAME: providertype
FIELD.COMMENT: 'core' (Moodle's own AI subsystem) or 'external' (arbitrary REST API).

FIELD.NAME: capability
FIELD.COMMENT: 'text' or 'multimodal'. Always 'text' for providertype=core, since core's generate_text action cannot accept files.

FIELD.NAME: corename
FIELD.COMMENT: For providertype=core: the specific core AI provider plugin name (e.g. aiprovider_openai), or blank for 'any available'.

FIELD.NAME: url
FIELD.COMMENT: For providertype=external: the API endpoint URL.

FIELD.NAME: username
FIELD.COMMENT: For providertype=external: optional username, for APIs that need one alongside the key.

FIELD.NAME: apikey
FIELD.COMMENT: For providertype=external: the API key/secret. Admin-only - never exposed to the question-editing form.

FIELD.NAME: headers
FIELD.COMMENT: For providertype=external: extra HTTP headers as JSON, e.g. {"Authorization":"Bearer ..."}.

FIELD.NAME: model
FIELD.COMMENT: For providertype=external: model identifier to include in the request, if applicable.

FIELD.NAME: returnpath
FIELD.COMMENT: For providertype=external: comma-separated key path to extract the answer from the JSON response, e.g. 'choices,0,message,content'.

FIELD.NAME: requesttemplate
FIELD.COMMENT: For providertype=external: JSON request body template, with tokens {{RUBRIC}}, {{TRANSCRIPT}}, {{AUDIO_BASE64}}, {{AUDIO_MIMETYPE}} substituted at call time. Lets each provider's own request shape be configured without hard-coding any one vendor's API.

FIELD.NAME: uploadstyle
FIELD.COMMENT: For providertype=external + capability=multimodal: how the audio/video file is sent - 'inline_base64' or 'upload_reference'. 'none' for text-only providers.

FIELD.NAME: uploadurl
FIELD.COMMENT: For uploadstyle=upload_reference: the endpoint used to upload the file itself, before referencing it in the main request (e.g. Gemini's resumable-upload endpoint). Separate from 'url' since the upload and generate endpoints are often different paths on the same host. Supports the {{APIKEY}} token.

FIELD.NAME: uploadprotocol
FIELD.COMMENT: For uploadstyle=upload_reference: which provider-specific upload protocol implementation to use (see classes/upload/). A real upload-then-reference flow is not expressible generically the way the main JSON request template is, so each supported protocol is its own PHP class, selected here by name.
